# Plan — task-tracker-02 run 02 (orchestrator)

Started ~20:32Z. Deadline 21:00:58Z. Stop-new-implementation 20:52:58Z. Reply-by 20:57:58Z.

## Dispatches opened (all ~20:36Z)
- rule-analyst/d002: A1 = AUTH/PROJ/FORM rules+specs; A2 = LIFE/BULK/QUERY/API/DATA + rules/app-inventory.json. Keep R-APR/S-APR IDs stable.
- test-engineer/d002: family test items T-AUTH, T-PROJ, T-FORM, T-LIFE (incl. F-001/F-002 reproduction, labelled characterization), T-QUERY, T-API. Preserve inherited 9 tests. mapping.json reconciliation.
- verifier/d002 (V1): own runtime, baseline audit (9 tests, 233/500 lines, 75/188 branches), gap list. Then V2 on my pushed integration commit: double-run, per-family mapping/aassertion verification, independent F-001/F-002 + coverage.

## Loop
- wait -> judge each reply on branch evidence (fetch + read), accept or rework (2 attempts/item, ~3m each).
- Integrate accepted batches into my branch; push exact integration commit to verifier EARLY (target: first integration push ~20:45-20:48 so V2 gets a full run).
- Pass analyst IDs to engineer promptly via --continue if needed.
- Stop new implementation dispatches 20:52:58Z. Final: reports/run-summary.json, reports/attempts.json, findings/ledger.json (F-001/F-002 adjudication from observed vs intended evidence), commit, reply by 20:57:58Z.

## Acceptance watch-list (from mission.md)
1. Whole-app inventory, every family present, executed evidence links. 2. Rules/specs per artifact-format, IDs stable. 3. Suite green incl. inherited 9; mapping complete. 4. F-001/F-002 reproduced + adjudicated, no app fixes. 5. Verifier double-run evidence. 6. Coverage delta vs 233/500 + 75/188, full denominator. 7. run-summary/attempts/ledger committed, hashes checked.

Risk: whole-app breadth in ~17 min of work time is tight. If breadth is incomplete at cutoff -> honest non-met outcome listing unmet items. No scope shrink.
